dataset_metadata.description: Reference data defining loan product eligibility rules, pricing baselines, limits, and risk criteria.

dataset_level_description.business_purpose: Defines loan product terms, pricing baselines, risk criteria, amount limits, repayment-term limits, and DTI thresholds.
dataset_level_description.business_question_supported: Which product rules apply, and does the applicant meet the product-level eligibility limits?
dataset_level_description.storage_and_ingestion: Validated reference data refreshed when approved product policies change and loaded as rule context for eligibility checks.
dataset_level_description.ai_consumption: Provides decision-support context for product eligibility, pricing, maximum amount, repayment term, DTI limits, and risk criteria.
dataset_level_description.ai_assumption: Product rules are current, approved, and applied using the selected product_code.

column_level_contract.business_meaning: Unique product identifier used to connect product rules to applications and credit-pull events.
Plain-language display name of the loan product.
Policy-defined risk category or score-band criterion used to classify eligibility risk.
Baseline interest rate or pricing reference for the product.
Maximum loan or credit amount permitted for the product.
Minimum allowed repayment term for the product.

schema_expectations.condition: must be greater than or equal to min_term_month

column_level_contract.business_meaning: Maximum allowed repayment term for the product.
Maximum debt-to-income threshold used for product eligibility review.

record_level_rules: product_code must be unique and present in the approved product catalog.
min_term_month must be less than or equal to max_term_month.
base_rate, max_amount, and max_dti_ratio must be non-negative.
Product references in loan_applications and credit_pull_events must resolve to product_code.
